topic: Still Building the Same Report by Hand? A 6-Step Automation Handoff

steps.safe_instruction: Write the decision this report supports and the person who owns that decision.

steps.record: Approved source · Owner · Timing · Access path
steps.safe_instruction: Record each approved source, its owner, update timing and access path.
Write the calculation, filter, grouping and exception rules in plain language.
Identify who reviews the output, what they check and what evidence is retained.
Define what happens when data is missing, late, duplicated or inconsistent.
Run the automated and manual versions together; release only after the authorized owner accepts the comparison.

minimum_handoff_record: Decision · Owners · Sources · Timing · Rules · Reviewer · Evidence · Fallback · Comparison · Release owner
